questions.intro: SEARCH VISIBILITY means people can find your site when they search. Basics: use the words customers actually type (for example "dog walker Eastfield" rather than "canine companionship solutions"); give each page a clear title and heading; write useful, original text; and for local businesses, keep the business name, address and phone the same everywhere and set up free local business listings. sections.skill: Labeling boxes in a storage room

questions.prompt: Which box label is easier to find?
questions.intro: If you label storage boxes "Stuff," nobody can find the winter coats. If you label one "Winter coats - adults," people find it quickly. Search engines are like a giant storage room. Clear page titles and the words people really use are good labels. Fancy labels that nobody searches for leave your box unfound, even if what is inside is exactly what people want.
